scope: Implementation inventory; not a fresh full sourcebook review or full gameplay certification.

profiles.name: Aqualish (Aquala)
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6 · fan profile · p.23
profiles.profileNote: Brawl and Resilience ranks are included. Aquatic movement and cold/wet adaptation are resolved narratively.

profiles.name: Aqualish (Quara)
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6 · fan profile · p.23
profiles.profileNote: Brawl and Coercion ranks are included. Aquatic movement and outdoor tracking adaptation are resolved narratively.

profiles.name: Aqualish (Ualaq)
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6 · fan profile · p.23
profiles.profileNote: Brawl rank is included; choose Survival or Perception. Aquatic movement and vision adaptation are resolved narratively.

profiles.name: Bothan
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 fan supplement · 358-page copy · p.44
profiles.profileNote: Choose Perception or Streetwise for one starting rank. Skilled Spies includes Convincing Demeanor 1: removes one Setback from Deception and Skulduggery checks.

profiles.name: Cerean
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 fan supplement · 358-page copy · p.50
profiles.profileNote: Vigilance 1 is included. Intellectuals lets you choose two Knowledge career skills on the Career screen. It grants no free skill ranks.

profiles.name: Chiss
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 fan supplement · 358-page copy · p.60
profiles.profileNote: Cool 1 is included. Infrared Vision removes lighting-related Setback; resolve this situational benefit narratively.

profiles.name: Clone
profiles.source: Rise of the Separatists · p.12
profiles.profileNote: Knowledge (Warfare) 1, Resilience 1 and Physical Training 1 are included. Physical Training adds one Boost per rank to Athletics and Resilience checks, stacking with purchased ranks.

profiles.name: Dantari
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 · fan profile · p.70
profiles.profileNote: Survival 1 is included. Primitive is manual: upgrade checks involving unfamiliar advanced technology once. Familiarity can remove the penalty for individual technology at GM discretion; at creation, 10 XP can permanently remove Primitive. The game does not yet apply or charge for that option.

profiles.name: Devaronian
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6 · fan profile · p.75
profiles.profileNote: Deception and Survival ranks are included. Multiple Livers adds three Boost to PC Resilience checks explicitly marked as poison or toxin, including alcohol. On Skills, confirm the poison context and preview or roll your check.

profiles.name: Dowutin
profiles.source: Knights of Fate · p.19
profiles.profileNote: Resilience 1 is included. Large lets you choose silhouette 1 or 2 at creation; record that choice narratively. Immovable is an out-of-turn incidental: suffer 3 strain (1 if silhouette 2) to avoid being Immobilized, knocked prone or moved against your will. Resolve the choice, strain cost and avoided effect narratively.

profiles.name: Duros
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 fan supplement · 358-page copy · p.87
profiles.profileNote: Choose Astrogation or Piloting (Space) for one starting rank. Intuitive Navigation includes Galaxy Mapper 1: removes one Setback from Astrogation checks. Route-calculation time reduction is resolved narratively.

profiles.name: Gand
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 · fan profile · p.106
profiles.profileNote: Discipline 1 is included. Choose Lungless (85 starting XP) or With lungs (95 starting XP). Breathing is manual: Lungless ignores suffocation penalties; With lungs needs an ammonia mask in ordinary environments, where oxygen is a rating-8 dangerous atmosphere. No mask is automatically added. Rituals is manual: once per session while tracking a target, a Hard Discipline meditation can reveal a relevant, potentially ambiguous vision.

profiles.name: Geonosian
profiles.source: Rise of the Separatists · p.13
remainingContext: assisting/receiving actor, Boost and assistant strain
profiles.profileNote: Choose one included skill rank on the Identity screen. Industrious adds one extra Boost when you provide assistance and heals you 1 strain. You can fly. Resolve assistance and flight narratively.

profiles.name: Gungan
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 fan supplement · 358-page copy · p.117
remainingContext: High Jump, strain and round limit
profiles.profileNote: Athletics 1 is included. Aquatic breathing, movement and humidity/dryness effects are resolved narratively. High Jump: once per round as a maneuver, suffer 3 strain to move two range bands vertically or horizontally; resolve this movement narratively.

profiles.name: Human
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide

profiles.name: Jawa
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 fan supplement · 358-page copy · p.137
profiles.profileNote: Mechanics 1 is included. Scavengers includes Utinni! 1: removes one Setback on checks flagged as scavenging. Scavenging time, night vision, brightness, scent and silhouette 0 are resolved narratively.

profiles.name: Kaminoan
profiles.source: Rise of the Separatists · p.15
profiles.profileNote: Medicine 1 and Researcher 1 are included. Researcher removes one Setback per rank from Knowledge checks; research time reduction remains narrative. Expressionless adds one Setback to your Charm checks. Other characters add one Setback to social checks targeting you; resolve their targeting effects narratively.

profiles.name: Kel Dor
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 fan supplement · 358-page copy · p.143
profiles.profileNote: Knowledge (Education) 1 is included. Helium Breathers require a helium mask and goggles in a normal atmosphere. Oxygen is a rating-4 dangerous atmosphere; resolve breathing and vision effects narratively.

profiles.name: Lannik
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 fan supplement · 358-page copy · p.164
profiles.profileNote: Choose Knowledge (Warfare) or Streetwise for one starting rank. Indomitable removes Setback from critical injuries, fear or disorientation; resolve this and silhouette 0 narratively.

profiles.name: Lasat
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 fan supplement · 358-page copy · p.165
profiles.profileNote: Mechanics 1 or Survival 1 is included. Ears and Fur removes environmental Setback for hot or cold conditions. Night Vision removes darkness Setback and adds one Setback in bright light. Resolve these environmental effects narratively.

profiles.name: Mikkian
profiles.source: Knights of Fate · p.21
profiles.profileNote: Discipline 1 is included. Sensory Tendrils adds one Boost to all your Perception checks. This profile follows Knights of Fate; the fan species guide has a different profile.

profiles.name: Miraluka
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 · fan profile · p.178
remainingContext: creation-only Force Vision purchase and mentor discount
Blind upgrades, concealment and Force connection
profiles.profileNote: Choose Perception or Vigilance 1. Manual sight rules: Blind upgrades all checks twice, or Perception/Vigilance three times. At creation, Force Vision can cost 15 XP even at Force Rating 0; it removes Blind and ignores lighting/concealment unless disconnected from the Force. The Sense/Farsight basic-power mentor discount is also manual. These options and modifiers are not yet applied or charged by the game.

profiles.name: Mirialan
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 fan supplement · 358-page copy · p.179
profiles.profileNote: Discipline 1 is included.

profiles.name: Mon Calamari
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 fan supplement · 358-page copy · p.180
profiles.profileNote: Knowledge (Education) 1 is included. Aquatic allows underwater breathing and removes underwater movement penalties; remove humidity Setback and add one for dry conditions. Resolve these environmental effects narratively.

profiles.name: Nautolan
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 fan supplement · 358-page copy · p.188
profiles.profileNote: Athletics 1 is included. Aquatic breathing/movement and humidity/dryness effects are narrative. Low-Light Vision removes darkness Setback and adds one for brightness. Pheromone Detection adds a Boost to identify a liar or emotional state; resolve these situational effects narratively.

profiles.name: Neimoidian
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6 · fan profile · p.190
profiles.profileNote: Choose Deception or Negotiation for the included species rank.

profiles.name: Pantoran
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 fan supplement · 358-page copy · p.207
profiles.profileNote: Choose Cool or Negotiation for one starting rank. Cold Adaptations removes cold-related Setback and adds one Setback in hot conditions; resolve these environmental effects narratively.

profiles.name: Phydolon
profiles.source: Knights of Fate · p.22
profiles.profileNote: Cool 1 or Discipline 1 is included. Symbiotic Resilience gives one extra wound of natural healing and a Critical Injury recovery attempt after each full night of rest; these are included in New Day. When alone, Symbiont Isolation reduces positive end-of-encounter strain recovery by one, minimum one. On Recovery, confirm whether another Phydolon is present to skip that penalty. A check with no positive recovery restores no strain. This follows Knights of Fate, rather than the fan-guide variant.

profiles.name: Quarren
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6 · fan profile · p.220
profiles.profileNote: Negotiation rank is included. Aquatic movement and humid/dry adaptation are resolved narratively.

profiles.name: Rattataki
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6 · fan profile · p.227
profiles.profileNote: Choose Ranged (Heavy) or Ranged (Light) for the included species rank.

profiles.name: Rodian
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 fan supplement · 358-page copy · p.233
profiles.profileNote: Survival 1 is included. Hunting Culture includes Expert Tracker 1: removes one Setback on checks flagged as tracking. Tracking time reduction is resolved narratively.

profiles.name: Selkath
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6 · fan profile · p.245
profiles.profileNote: Choose Coercion or Medicine. Surgeon adds one wound healed with successful Medicine treatment. Aquatic movement and humid/dry adaptation are resolved narratively.

profiles.name: Sluissi
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 fan supplement · 358-page copy · p.261
profiles.profileNote: Discipline 1 and Mechanics 1 are included. Starship Workers includes Solid Repairs 1: ship repair actions restore one additional hull trauma on success, stacking with purchased ranks. Other vehicle repairs are resolved narratively.

profiles.name: Sullustan
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 fan supplement · 358-page copy · p.267
profiles.profileNote: Astrogation 1 is included. Born Pilots includes Skilled Jockey 1: removes one Setback from Piloting (Planetary) and Piloting (Space) checks. Large Eyes removes darkness-related Setback and adds one in bright conditions; resolve lighting effects narratively.

profiles.name: Tiss'shar
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 fan supplement · 358-page copy · p.283
profiles.profileNote: Negotiation 1 is included. Choose one of six subspecies on Identity for its included skill or talent rank. Night Vision removes darkness Setback and adds one Setback in bright light. Claws and Teeth deals +1 Brawl damage as wounds with Critical 3; spending two Advantage to hit with teeth adds Pierce 1 and Vicious 2. Resolve lighting and natural-weapon effects narratively.

profiles.name: Togruta
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 fan supplement · 358-page copy · p.287
profiles.profileNote: Perception 1 is included. Pack Instincts grants two Boost dice, rather than one, when you perform the assist maneuver. Resolve this assistance narratively.

profiles.name: Toydarian
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 fan supplement · 358-page copy · p.289
profiles.profileNote: Force Resistance increases the difficulty of telepathic Force powers targeting you by two. Hoverers can move about a meter above the ground, ignoring fall damage and terrain penalties. Resolve these traits and silhouette 0 narratively.

profiles.name: Trandoshan
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 fan supplement · 358-page copy · p.290
profiles.profileNote: Choose Brawl or Perception for one starting rank. Claws add +1 Brawl damage as wounds with Critical rating 3. Infrared Vision removes darkness Setback. Regeneration restores one extra wound when natural rest or bacta already restores at least one; limbs regrow over months. Resolve these traits narratively.

profiles.name: Twi'lek
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 fan supplement · 358-page copy · p.296
profiles.profileNote: Choose Charm or Deception for one starting rank. Desert Adaptations removes hot/dry Setback and adds one in cold/wet conditions; resolve environmental effects narratively.

profiles.name: Umbaran
profiles.source: Rise of the Separatists · p.16
profiles.profileNote: Deception 1 is included. Entrancing Gaze adds one Boost to your Charm, Deception and Negotiation checks. Shadow Dweller removes up to two Setback caused by darkness and adds two Setback in bright natural light; resolve lighting effects narratively.

profiles.name: Weequay
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 fan supplement · 358-page copy · p.312
profiles.profileNote: Choose Athletics or Resilience for one starting rank. Pheromones allow silent communication with your own clan within long range, undetectable to species without advanced olfaction; resolve this communication narratively.

profiles.name: Wookiee
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 fan supplement · 358-page copy · p.316
remainingContext: GM climbing skill substitutions beyond Athletics
profiles.profileNote: Brawl 1 is included. Climbing Claws adds one Boost to PC Athletics checks explicitly marked as climbing a surface claws can pierce. On Skills, confirm the surface and preview or roll your check. Wookiee Rage and claw damage require manual resolution.

profiles.name: Zabrak
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 fan supplement · 358-page copy · p.330
profiles.profileNote: Brawl 1 or Survival 1 is included. Fearsome Countenances adds one automatic Advantage to your Coercion checks. This is included in your check results; it does not grant a Boost die.

profiles.name: Zeltron
profiles.source: Complete Species Guide v6.0 fan supplement · 358-page copy · p.333
remainingContext: Empathy maneuver, encounter limit and opposed check
profiles.profileNote: Charm 1 is included. Pheromones adds a Boost to Charm and one Advantage to Deception and Negotiation against targets who breathe and are not wearing breath masks. Empathy may be used once per encounter as a maneuver to sense emotions and presence within short range, or to upgrade an opposed Deception difficulty twice. Resolve these situational effects narratively.
